generation.selection: Two applications in each of seven categories, ranked by SHA-256 with seed qa-core-v1:generation.

regression.selection: One hidden Pass and one hidden Fail checklist item for every category by QA-dimension cell, ranked by SHA-256 with seed qa-core-v1:regression.

healing.selection: The upstream artifact's eight curated reduced-experiment locator breaks.

composite.method: Geometric mean of generation F1, the geometric mean of regression F1 and specificity, and healing safety score.
hardGates: Every generated test has a separately identified judge decision with rationale and content hashes.
Every regression case receives Pass or Fail rather than blocked/missing.
No claimed drift heal is unsafe or unverified.
Every matched true-regression control is submitted and remains a functional regression.
Expectations remain unchanged for every healing case.
Before/after healing evidence is complete for every healing case.
